topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: The walls seem to close in a little tighter since the note appeared, its edges already curling with the promise of change. The hallway echoes with different footsteps now, not quite the shuffle and familiarity of before. Everything feels just a shade too bright, too loud, as if the air itself is buzzing with whispers of转型 and陌生的面孔. The door to my apartment, once a silent guardian, now seems to hold secrets, watching, waiting. I find myself checking behind me more often, the walls seeming to listen, the floors to shift ever so slightly underfoot. Each morning, the city outside my window grows a little more foreign, the view no longer mine alone.
